title: 微软站会指南：怎样控制时长、处理阻碍
topic: 微软站会指南：怎样控制时长、处理阻碍

source.title: Agile Ceremonies - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课选取微软 Engineering Fundamentals Playbook 的完整 Stand-Up 小节。原文给出的 15 分钟安排是建议示例，不是普遍标准；原文个别句子有不自然的语法，本课在语言练习中使用自然表达并作出标注。
paragraphs: The stand-up helps the team understand what was done, what will be done and what are the blockers.
The stand-up helps the team understand if they will meet the sprint goal or not.
Keep stand up short and efficient. Table the longer conversations for a parking lot section, or for a conversation that will be planned later.
Run daily stand ups: 15 minutes of stand up and 15 minutes of parking lot.
If someone cannot make the stand-up exceptionally: Ask them to do a written stand up in advance.
Stand ups should include everyone involved in the project, including the customer.
Projects with widely divergent time zones should be avoided if possible, but if you are on one, you should adapt the standups to meet the needs and time constraints of all team members.
translations: 站会帮助团队了解已完成的工作、接下来要做的工作，以及遇到的阻碍。
站会帮助团队判断能否达到冲刺目标。
站会要短而高效；较长的讨论先列入“待讨论事项”，或另行安排时间讨论。
原文建议每日站会用 15 分钟，并另留 15 分钟处理待讨论事项。这是该指南给出的安排示例，不是所有团队都必须遵守的标准。
如果有人偶尔无法参加站会，请让对方提前提交书面进展。
站会应包括所有参与项目的人，也包括客户。
指南建议尽量避免跨时区差异很大的项目；如果无法避免，就应调整站会，以适应所有团队成员的需求和时间限制。
fullTextParagraphs: The stand-up helps the team understand what was done, what will be done and what are the blockers.
The stand-up helps the team understand if they will meet the sprint goal or not.
Keep stand up short and efficient. Table the longer conversations for a parking lot section, or for a conversation that will be planned later.
Run daily stand ups: 15 minutes of stand up and 15 minutes of parking lot.
If someone cannot make the stand-up exceptionally: Ask them to do a written stand up in advance.
Stand ups should include everyone involved in the project, including the customer.
Projects with widely divergent time zones should be avoided if possible, but if you are on one, you should adapt the standups to meet the needs and time constraints of all team members.

notes.explain: 会议中先登记较长议题，之后再安排时间讨论；不要让它占用简短站会。
notes.example: Let’s table the pricing question and schedule a follow-up.

notes.explain: 指会议中暂时搁置、留待会后或另一次会议处理的议题。原文没有规定每个团队必须使用同一个流程。
notes.example: I’ll add that question to the parking lot.

notes.phrase: a written stand up in advance
notes.meaning: 提前提交书面站会更新
notes.explain: 原文建议成员偶尔无法出席时提前书面更新。原句 “cannot make ... exceptionally” 不自然；日常表达可说 “If you can’t make the stand-up…”。
notes.example: If you can’t make the stand-up, please send a written update in advance.

notes.phrase: what was done, what will be done and what are the blockers
notes.meaning: 已完成的工作 / 接下来的工作 / 阻碍
notes.explain: 这三项对应原文描述的站会用途。原文把间接问句写成 “what are the blockers”；自然语序应为 “what the blockers are”。
notes.example: Let’s cover what’s done, what’s next, and any blockers.

scenario.title: Stand-up keeps running over time
english: Sarah leads a mobile-app team whose daily stand-up often runs long.
Updates turn into a detailed API discussion, so the team has little time to raise blockers or check progress toward the sprint goal.
One teammate will occasionally miss the meeting because of a customer call. Sarah wants to keep the stand-up focused and agree on a useful way to handle longer topics and absences.
chinese: Sarah 带领一个手机应用团队，团队的每日站会经常超时。
进展汇报常常变成详细的 API 讨论，团队反而没有多少时间提出阻碍或确认冲刺目标进展。
有位同事偶尔会因客户电话缺席。Sarah 想让站会聚焦，并约定怎样处理较长议题和缺席情况。

firstAttempt.prompt: 站会经常超时：大家开始讨论 API 细节，阻碍和冲刺目标反而没谈到。请用英文建议把站会控制在 15 分钟，聚焦进展和阻碍，并把长讨论另行安排。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we keep the stand-up to 15 minutes and focus on what’s done, what’s next, and any blockers? We can put the API discussion in the parking lot and schedule a follow-up.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先提出短会时长和讨论范围，再把 API 深入讨论留到后续；不把示例时长包装成公司统一政策。

words.meaning: 站会；简短的团队进度会
words.example: Could we keep the daily stand-up to 15 minutes?
words.translation: 我们能否把每日站会控制在 15 分钟？
words.note: 这里指团队定期进行的简短同步会议。原文中的 15 分钟是示例安排。

words.example: Please raise any blocker that could affect the sprint goal.
words.translation: 如果有可能影响冲刺目标的阻碍，请提出来。
words.note: 工作语境中指妨碍下一步推进、需要关注或协作解决的问题。

words.meaning: 暂缓某个议题，留待之后讨论
words.example: Let’s table the API discussion and schedule a follow-up.
words.translation: 我们先把 API 讨论留到之后，再另约时间。
words.note: 这里的 table 是动词，意为暂缓议题；它不表示把话题“摆上桌面”。

words.meaning: 会议中暂存、稍后处理的议题列表
words.collocation: put a topic in the parking lot
words.example: We can put the detailed design question in the parking lot.
words.translation: 我们可以把详细设计问题先列入待讨论事项。
words.note: 是一种会议管理用语；是否另开后续会议由团队决定。

words.collocation: send a written update in advance
words.example: If you can’t attend, please send a written update in advance.
words.translation: 如果你无法参加，请提前发一份书面进展。
words.note: 原文建议有人偶尔无法参会时提前提交书面 stand-up 更新。

words.example: The team checks whether its current work supports the sprint goal.
words.translation: 团队会检查当前工作是否有助于实现冲刺目标。
words.note: 不要把短会说成只收集个人状态；原文也强调关注团队能否达到冲刺目标。

structure.original: Table the longer conversations for a parking lot section, or for a conversation that will be planned later.
analysis: 祈使句以动词原形 Table 开头，省略主语 you，用于给出直接建议。
the longer conversations 是 table 的宾语，表示要暂缓的较长讨论。
for a parking lot section 补充议题暂存的位置；or 后说明另一种做法，即另行安排讨论。
table 在此是动词“暂缓”，不是“放到桌上”。在团队沟通中可改成委婉提议：“Could we table the longer discussion and schedule a follow-up?”
structure.transfer: Could we keep the stand-up to 15 minutes and focus on progress and blockers? We can table longer topics for a follow-up.

rewrite.bad: We don’t have time for this. Take it offline.
rewrite.good: Could we keep the stand-up to 15 minutes and focus on what’s done, what’s next, and any blockers? We can put the API discussion in the parking lot and schedule a follow-up.
rewrite.translation: 我们能否把站会控制在 15 分钟，聚焦已完成的工作、下一步和阻碍？我们可以把 API 讨论列入待讨论事项，再另约时间。
rewrite.pattern: Could we keep [the meeting] to [a time limit] and focus on [key points]? We can table [a longer topic] and [arrange a follow-up].

cloze.prompt: Could we keep the stand-up ___ 15 minutes?
cloze.why: keep the meeting to + 时长表示把会议控制在该时长。

cloze.prompt: Let’s put the API discussion in the parking ___.
cloze.why: parking lot 是会议中暂存议题的列表。

cloze.prompt: If you can’t attend, please send a written update in ___.

dictation.text: The stand-up helps the team understand what was done, what will be done, and any blockers.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 站会要覆盖的信息
dictation.why: 听出已完成事项、下一步和阻碍三类信息。注意这是自然改写，不是对原文错误语序的逐字朗读。

dictation.text: Keep the stand-up short and efficient. Table longer conversations for a follow-up.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 长议题留待后续
dictation.why: table a conversation 表示暂缓讨论。

apply.prompt: 两地团队找不到都方便的站会时间。请提出调整时间，并说明缺席者可提前怎么做。
apply.sample: Could we adjust the stand-up time to work for both time zones? If you can’t attend, please send a written update in advance.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否把站会控制在 15 分钟，聚焦已完成的工作、下一步和阻碍？
translationPractice.answer: Could we keep the stand-up to 15 minutes and focus on what’s done, what’s next, and any blockers?
translationPractice.why: 用 keep ... to 15 minutes 提建议，并列出站会重点。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们可以把 API 讨论先列入待讨论事项，再另约时间。
translationPractice.answer: Let’s put the API discussion in the parking lot and schedule a follow-up.
translationPractice.why: 用 parking lot 暂存长议题，并明确后续安排。

translationPractice.prompt: 如果你偶尔无法参加，请提前发一份书面进展。
translationPractice.answer: If you can’t attend, please send a written update in advance.
translationPractice.why: 用条件句说明缺席时如何提前更新。

choice.prompt: 有位同事因客户电话偶尔无法参加站会。根据原文，怎样做最合适？
options: Ask them to join a different call while the team repeats the meeting for them.
Ask them to send a written stand-up update in advance.
Leave their work and blockers out of the sprint discussion.
choice.why: 原文建议成员偶尔无法参加时提前提交书面站会更新；并没有要求重复开会或忽略其工作。

output.prompt: 跨时区项目成员总是要在不方便的时间参加站会。请写两句话：建议调整时间以适应双方；如果有人仍无法参加，请说明可以提前提交什么。
output.sample: Could we adjust the stand-up time to work for both time zones? If you can’t attend, please send a written update in advance.
check: 是否提出了适应双方时区的时间调整？
是否说明无法参会者可以提前提交书面进展？
是否没有把书面更新说成所有团队的强制要求？
